record.title: SELECT durable learning — current-substrate reconstitution and family-local verifier identity
record.body: Durable learning: when a high-value semantic capability exists only on a deeply divergent branch, preserve the branch as provenance and reconstitute the capability on the exact current substrate instead of force-rebasing stale implementation truth. A verifier must bind the identity of its semantic family, not infer identity from globally reused numeric ordinals. R67 first exact-head execution falsified the global-ordinal assumption because current marketplace legitimately contained another 651 court; binding the exact 50 query filenames repaired composition without weakening any semantic CTQ. Consumer-count evidence must likewise be family/causal-root aware: repository count alone is not independent evidence. This learning applies to future sensor/verifier factories and cross-repo consumer qualification.

metadata.falsifier: numeric query ordinals are not globally unique across sensor families
metadata.repair: bind exact semantic query filenames/family identity
